result.scope: Analytic gravity demand for the listed rigid members about one fixed axis. A stop mean assumes release from rest and only gravity work. Moving disable, achieved clearance, peak loads and installed holding capacity require separate evidence.

rotaryReview.note: stow holding with article -0.559 N m (was -0.562): gravity still closes onto the stow stop. At -2 deg the empty pan gravity opens with 3.95 N m toward the soft stop.

findings: All 12 cases keep, release, support and hold both pipes, and meet every reset, in all five revised variants at both stiffness bounds, at 30 A and unpowered. Branch voltage >= 9.66 V (four-terminal) and >= 9.71 V (low-line).

Support criterion: the 5420 N m/rad runs (1.8324 mm) and 4210 unpowered (1.8312 mm) meet 1.83 mm. 4210 at 30 A gives 1.8249 mm and the no-stop revised reference 1.8277 mm, below 1.83 by 5.1 and 2.3 um. The old baseline (1.8283) was itself 1.7 um below 1.83, so the criterion has no resolution at this level. Nominal placement 2 governs.
Reset: minimum 74.4-79.5 ms for the proposal vs 89.8 ms old baseline and 90.5 ms revised no-stop reference. The softer stop bound gives more reset margin.

The -5 deg soft stop is struck in NORMAL adverse dumps, not only in faults. The commanded dump is -2 deg minus +0.04 rad pitch = -4.29 deg in the pan frame, and the pan overshoots to -5.09 deg (2.0-2.1 N m, about 20 N per pad). The package assumes a 3 deg gap at dump; the adverse gap is 0.71 deg before overshoot.

Correction to commissioning.md and study 01: the 29.62 A peak is at the end of the adverse dump (t=47.69 s, pan at -6.7 deg), not during the station feed. With the soft stop catching the overshoot the peak falls to 20.7-22.5 A and the branch voltage rises (9.42 -> 9.66 V four-terminal).
Adverse release moves 43-61 ms later with the soft stop in place. Support margins there are about 30 mm, so this does not govern.
limits: One-plane rigid pan about a fixed pivot; stop is a lumped linear spring-damper (no pad nonlinearity, set, temperature or wear).
Power loss modeled as zero motor torque only; NEO 550 brake-mode, gearbox back-drive friction and controller reboot behaviour are not modeled (back-drive friction would help).
Preload is an ideal torque law; real spring geometry, hysteresis and attachment not designed.
Pad contact point and push direction enter only through the lever; no 3-D stop force model.
Reflected rotor inertia 0.00902 kg m2 is the package assumption, not a measured value.
nextSteps: Decide whether the soft stop may be touched in normal adverse dumps, or move it or the dump command so the 3 deg gap holds at +0.04 rad pitch.
Confirm the gearbox output-stage rating for >= 18.9 N m (F1), or add an interlock that bounds it; current bound 7.1 N m.
Bench-measure stow and soft pad stiffness and loss; replay again if series stiffness < 3000 N m/rad.
After the native build, check the revised mass properties against the reconciliation.
